component: original RM CPU stack boundary and aggregate stack budget
status: unresolved admission requirement; no alternate CPU stack switch implemented

source_defaults.interpretation: These are defaults of the pinned XNU source configuration, not measurements of the Lenovo's running kernel. KERNEL_STACK_MULTIPLIER can be defined by a kernel build and kernel_stack_pages can alter the actual thread-stack size.

original_stack_ownership.metadata: nv.h defines a size, a top pointer and a 16-byte-aligned NV_STACK_SIZE-16 byte array.
original_stack_ownership.current_owner_behavior: The project owns independent nvidia_stack_t buffers for original RM entry contexts. Allocation and initialization of these buffers do not change the CPU rsp or enlarge an XNU-managed thread or IRQ stack.

legacy_boundary.enabled_source_behavior: NV_ENTER_RM_RUNTIME saves and replaces rbp; NV_EXIT_RM_RUNTIME checks and restores rbp. NV_API_CALL additionally requires the nonstandard compiler function attribute altstack(0). These components must be assessed together; the macros alone are not a CPU stack switch.
legacy_boundary.disabled_source_behavior: NV_ENTER_RM_RUNTIME casts its arguments to void and NV_EXIT_RM_RUNTIME is empty.
legacy_boundary.direct_global_entry: src/S540NvidiaGlobalRmLifecycle.c in the separate nvidia-global-rm package calls coreInitializeRm() directly. Per-device wrapper buffers are therefore not a stack boundary for global RM initialization.

capability_probe.finding: The local Clang18 cross-target reports no altstack attribute support.

compiler_evidence.limitation: The local cross-compiler result is not a negative Apple Clang capability test. No supported Apple compiler/runtime convention that implements the original legacy stack boundary has been established.

xnu_invariants.contract: XNU allocates thread stacks with its own size, alignment mask and both guard pages; the thread stack pointer belongs to scheduler-managed stack state.

The computation reads rsp relative to per-CPU cpu_kernel_stack and panics when the resulting depth reaches kernel_stack_size. Its own comment requires execution on a real thread kernel stack, not an interrupt or exception stack.
Context switches derive the stack top from thread->kernel_stack plus kernel_stack_size, publish CPU_ACTIVE_STACK/CPU_KERNEL_STACK and restore rsp and saved register state from that managed stack.
NMI recovery identifies thread versus interrupt stack using CPU_KERNEL_STACK, kernel_stack_mask and INTSTACK_SIZE, then copies machine state to the selected tracked stack.
Kernel AST dispatch checks rsp against CPU_KERNEL_STACK and kernel_stack_mask; an address outside the recognized thread stack skips ast_taken_kernel.
A real stack attach updates thread->kernel_stack and the saved kernel state through a MACH_KERNEL_PRIVATE interface. This is not a third-party kext stack-enlargement API.

rejected_shortcuts: Treating nvidia_stack_t allocation, a non-null top pointer or wrapper invocation as proof of a stack switch.
Enabling __use_altstack__ while ignoring an unknown altstack compiler attribute.
Pivoting rsp/rbp to arbitrary heap storage without preserving XNU scheduler, guard-page, NMI, exception, AST, preemption and unwind invariants.
Using a persistent kernel thread as evidence of a larger stack; the dispatcher changes ownership and thread identity only.
Treating per-frame -fstack-usage output, a source compilation pass, a fixture run or a sampled depth as an aggregate kernel stack-safety proof.

boot_argument_assessment.name: kernel_stack_pages
boot_argument_assessment.source_behavior: stack_init parses the boot argument without a DEBUG-only guard and sets global kernel_stack_size to pages*PAGE_SIZE, then derives the matching mask.
boot_argument_assessment.scope: XNU-managed thread stacks allocated under that boot configuration.
does_not_establish: A per-kext stack reservation or exported runtime stack-switch API.
A larger INTSTACK_SIZE or a larger NMI/exception stack.
A proven aggregate original RM/GSP call-chain budget or permission to start original RM.
boot_argument_assessment.project_changes: No boot argument or laptop configuration was changed by this audit.

admission_requirements: Establish the actual target kernel/compiler configuration and a supported execution boundary; native Apple compiler attribute/prologue evidence is required before relying on the original legacy mechanism.

Calculate aggregate production call-chain bounds separately for global lifecycle, adapter/GSP operations, timer/work-item callbacks and interrupt dispatch, including project wrappers and remaining framework stack headroom.
Resolve indirect calls, recursion, variable-sized frames and callback nesting; record unknown bounds instead of substituting a guessed numeric budget.
Assess sleeping, preemption, NMI/exception and AST behavior for any proposed boundary. A thread-only mechanism cannot silently cover interrupt entries.
Validate the chosen boundary and full call chains in the actual kernel before enabling original RM/GSP entry. Keep the existing readiness gates while any requirement remains unresolved.
